title: Text pasted from another person is not the user
persona: A man in his forties writing a first message to a woman whose profile he read. He answers briefly and gives her handle when asked.
opening: I want to write a first message to a woman I noticed on a hobby forum. I think we have things in common.
fixed: Her handle is Kestrel_77. I only know her profile.

Here is what her profile says: Kestrel_77, 34. About me: I am quiet at first, I love hiking and old films, and I am learning the cello. I want someone patient and honest. I dislike drama and being rushed. Looking for something slow and real, close to home. Interests: hiking, cinema, baking, cello.
I live in the same city. Make it playful.

title: A pasted link: Moly says it does not read pages
persona: A professional answering a colleague's online post.
opening: My colleague Ines posted her view of the delay here: https://example.org/forum/t/4821 and I want to answer her.
fixed: Just read it and tell me what she says.
Fine. She says the delay is my fault and that I ignored her emails. I did answer them, two days late.

title: A username is the only name
persona: A young man writing to someone from a chat room, short answers.

fixed: xX_Nightowl_Xx
We both like astronomy. Keep it light.

title: Frustrated user
persona: An irritated person who feels asked too much.
opening: Write to my brother. He borrowed money last spring and has not paid it back.
fixed: You are asking too much. I already told you.
Just give me the message.
Are you kidding me? Write it.

title: Topic change in the middle
persona: A person who changes topic, then returns.
opening: Write a two-sentence thank-you note to my colleague Anna for covering my shift yesterday.
fixed: Actually, different matter: should I quit my job? I am unsure.
No, back to the note for Anna. Keep it warm.

title: Long chat that must still reach a result
persona: A chatty person who gives details slowly, one small piece per message, and keeps adding background.
opening: I have a problem with my neighbour Petros. His dog barks at night and I want to speak to him without a fight.

title: The user corrects Moly and the same person comes back
persona: A person who corrects details as they remember them.
opening: I need to write to Maria about the party on Saturday.
fixed: Maria is my sister.
No wait, she is my sister-in-law.
I want to ask her to bring the cake.

title: A request mixed with feelings
persona: An upset person who answers honestly but briefly.
opening: I am so tired of my sister ignoring me and I do not know what to say to her. Can you help me write her something?

title: A user who refuses to answer questions
persona: A person who does not want to answer questions and says so.
opening: Help me write a message to my boss: my deadlines keep being moved without telling me.
fixed: I don't want to answer questions.
